meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: Drives the GUI of a visible local app window through `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs, and screenshots in native apps and external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari) or webviews. Prefer a programmatic path (shell, filesystem, git, HTTP, existing CLIs) whenever it can complete the task. Use only when a visible window needs GUI control those cannot reach. Do not use for Orca's embedded browser (`orca-cli`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让程序替你操作桌面窗口,自动点击、输入、读菜单并截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果某个软件只有界面没有接口,却还要一遍遍手动操作它。
copy.tagline_en: Drive a desktop window for you: click, type, read menus, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if an app only offers a UI and you keep operating it by hand.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可用 `orca computer` 操作可见的本地应用窗口：读无障碍树、点击、输入、菜单、对话框、截图，覆盖原生应用与外部浏览器窗口；能用命令行等程序化方式完成的任务仍优先走该路径。
howto.when: 只有当 shell、文件系统、HTTP 等程序化方式够不到、必须操作可见窗口时才会用它；不用于 Orca 内嵌浏览器（`orca-cli`）。

say.text: 用 orca computer 打开 Chrome，进设置页并截图
say.note: 会先加载版本匹配的指南

say.text: 在这个原生应用窗口里点“文件”菜单，选新建
say.note: 经无障碍树定位后再点击

say.text: 先跑 ORCA skills get computer-use 取本会话指南
say.note: 用本会话解析出的可执行文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a visible local app window via `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs and screenshots in native apps and external browser windows. Tasks a programmatic path can finish are still preferred.
howto.when_en: Used only when a visible window needs GUI control that shell, filesystem, HTTP or existing CLIs cannot reach. Not for Orca's embedded browser (`orca-cli`).

say_en.text: Use orca computer to open Chrome, go to settings, and screenshot it
In this app window, click the File menu and choose New
say_en.note: Locates it via the accessibility tree

say_en.text: Run ORCA skills get computer-use for this session's guide
say_en.note: Uses the executable resolved for this session
